main.description: A per-article permission grant, stored in the wiki owner's repo. The rkey is a TID. Grants scope a single member's access to one article of one wiki, overriding the wiki-wide picture for that page.

wikiRef.description: AT-URI of the wiki containing the article.

noteSlug.description: Slug of the granted article. Slugs are permanent within a wiki, so the grant survives record rewrites.

memberDid.description: DID of the member being granted access.

role.description: The member's role on this article. 'admin' can also review suggestions for it; 'editor' can propose full edits; 'suggester' can propose text-only edits; 'viewer' can read.
